The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4a9f78651b522ce7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: There are labelled graphs (Θi)i≥1 satisfying all the hypotheses of Section 2, with the following additional properties. Write ni = | Vert(Θi)|, ki = ⌊ni/2⌋, and let σi be the girth. There are constants ρ, κ > 0, independent of i, such that: (i) On the orthogonal complement of constants in ℓ2(Vert(Θi)), dI − AdjΘi ≥ ρI, and for every vertex subset W, |∂W| ≥ κ min{|W|, ni − |W|}. (7) Here ∂W is the unoriented edge boundary in Θi. (ii) With c = η 2 min{κ, 1}, (8) we have ni > 100, σi > max{16, 20/c}, λσi > 3, and 1 < ⌊λσi⌋ < ⌊λσi+1⌋. (iii) Every induced intrinsic ball of radius at most σi/16 is a tree with fewer than ηni vertices. (iv) The integers ki strictly increase and ki+1 − ki → ∞. Consequently every ball BP in Lemma 2.4, for every permitted root and chosen root geodesic, is an induced tree satisfying rP ≤ σ(P)/16, |BP | < η|P|. (9)
